name: Checkout button
description: Goes to checkout; disabled while the cart is empty.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/checkout-button", name: "Checkout button", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Goes to checkout; disabled while the cart is empty.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Button(label: cart.count > 0 ? "Checkout · ${formatMoney(cart.total_cents)}" : "Your cart is empty", fullWidth: true, size: Size.lg, disabled: cart.count == 0, onTap: Navigate(to: Route.checkout))
  )], data: [Data(name: "cart", from: Client.cart(), fetch: "client", type: Cart)],
)
